summary: Both backend and frontend tested end-to-end. All 6 pytest backend tests pass (root brand message, validation 422, structured Counsel's Brief generation via Claude Sonnet 4.5, MongoDB persistence with no _id leakage, session continuation). Frontend hero, sections, nav anchors, suggestion chips, search submission, loading panel, and LLM result render — all functional with correct data-testids.

issues: LLM answer rendered with whitespace-pre-wrap; raw Markdown markers like ** ** and ## are visible as literal characters. Consider rendering with a Markdown component (e.g., react-markdown) for the 'Counsel's Brief' panel — purely a polish item, not a functional break.
A trailing literal '|' caret character is visible next to the period in 'Accountability Is Real.|'. Confirm this is intentional (typewriter caret animation) — appears static in this build.

action_items: (Optional) Render search answer with Markdown parser so ** ** and ## display as bold/headings instead of literal characters.
(Optional) Verify hero tagline caret '|' is meant to be static or should animate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean, uses async motor, excludes _id in find projections — good.
App.js is ~645 lines; still readable but approaching the 700-line guideline — consider splitting Hero/SearchBar/Sections into separate component files for maintainability.
SearchBar swallows error details on failure — toast says generic message; could log structured error to aid debugging.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent for testability.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Two search documents created in db.searches as part of backend tests (kept for /api/searches verification).
